snippet.title: Reality Breach – Official Reveal Trailer | A Psychological Horror Experience
snippet.description:
Reality Breach is a first-person psychological horror game.

You play as Theo, an exhausted game developer whose reality is about to be breached by his own creations. Uncover his story, survive what hunts you, and make choices that shape his ending.

Wishlist to save Theo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118910/Reality_Breach/

Music: NEFFEX - Anxiety

#indiegame #horrorgame #psychologicalhorror #steamgame #gaming #survivalhorror
